description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.desc: Bills HC Joe Brady said starters will play against the Panthers in the preseason opener.
items.impact: Allen and the starters will have an opportunity to knock off any lingering rust while building momentum for the regular season.
items.title: Josh Allen will play in preseason opener

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Chuba Hubbard (hamstring) is week-to-week with a hamstring injury per HC Dave Canales. He is expected to play in Week 1.
items.impact: While it sounds like Hubbard should be good to go for the season opener, he could still be limited following a multi-week absence. With that said, it's now wheels up for Jonathon Brooks, who's now going to see his ADP rise yet again.
items.title: Chuba Hubbard (hamstring) week-to-week with hamstring injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bills released DL Kody Huisman.
items.impact: Huisman will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Kody Huisman released by Bills

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bills signed CB Anthony Kendall.
items.impact: Kendall will compete in training camp for a depth role in the Bills corner back room.
items.title: Anthony Kendall signs with Bills

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings waived RB Jordan Mims.
items.impact: Mims signed with Minnesota in late July. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Jordan Mims waived by Vikings

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: John Michael Schmitz Jr. did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Schmitz was placed in concussion protocol earlier this week. He'll have to clear all protocols before he can return to practice.
items.title: John Michael Schmitz Jr. (concussion) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: JuJu Smith-Schuster did not practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Smith-Schuster is continuing to battle a knee injury. He is competing for a depth role in the Giants wide receiver room.
items.title: JuJu Smith-Schuster (knee) misses practice Wednesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Saints signed DT Kahlil Saunders.
items.impact: Saunders previously participated in training camp with the Dolphins. He'll compete for a depth role with New Orleans.
items.title: Kahlil Saunders signs with Saints

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Saints placed OL Dillon Radunz on injured reserve.
items.impact: Radunz tore his ACL in practice last week. He'll miss the upcoming season.
items.title: Dillon Radunz (knee) placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans waived WR Montrell Washington.
items.impact: Washington signed with Houston last week. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Montrell Washington waived by Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Texans signed K Chris Freeman.
items.impact: Freeman will see some reps during the preseason.
items.title: Chris Freeman signs with Texans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Raiders waived offensive guard Justin Pickett with an injury designation.
items.impact: Pickett will seek another opportunity when he is cleared. Las Vegas signed Braeden Daniels as the corresponding move.
items.title: Justin Pickett waived by Raiders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Raiders signed OL Braeden Daniels.
items.impact: Daniels spent most of last season on the Dolphins' practice squad. He will compete for a depth role on the Raiders offensive line.
items.title: Braeden Daniels signs with Raiders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers waived/injured K.J. Henry.
items.impact: Henry signed with San Francisco in late July. He'll seek another opportunity when he is cleared.
items.title: K.J. Henry waived by 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers waived P Jack Bouwmeester.
items.impact: Bouwmeester signed a contract with San Francisco in July. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Jack Bouwmeester waived by 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers waived WR Junior Bergen.
items.impact: Bergen will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Junior Bergen waived by 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers signed DL Xavier Thomas.
items.impact: Thomas spent last season on the Texans practice squad. He will compete for a depth role on a banged up 49ers defensive line.
items.title: Xavier Thomas signs with 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers signed CB Eli Apple.
items.impact: Apple will compete for a depth role in the 49ers secondary.
items.title: Eli Apple signs with 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Browns signed CB Jeremiah McClendon.
items.impact: McClendon will compete for a depth role in the Browns secondary.
items.title: Jeremiah McClendon signs with Browns

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Patriots waived/injured Myles Montgomery.
items.impact: Montgomery will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp when he is cleared.
items.title: Myles Montgomery waived by Patriots

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jalin Hyatt is expected to return to practice soon.
items.impact: Hyatt "had someone fall on him late the other day" which led to his absence from practice on Wednesday.
items.title: Jalin Hyatt expected to return to practice soon

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Paulson Adebo is day-to-day with an undisclosed injury.
items.impact: Adebo should return to practice later this week or early next week.
items.title: Paulson Adebo (undisclosed) day-to-day

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Elandon Roberts has agreed to a 1-year contract with the Pittsburgh Steelers.
items.impact: Roberts played for the Steelers in 2023 and 2024 before joining the Raiders last season, and he will now return to Pittsburgh. The linebacker played in 17 games with Las Vegas, totaling 90 combined tackles and six tackles for loss.
items.title: Elandon Roberts signs 1-year deal with Steelers

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Darren Waller has agreed to a 1-year contract with the Carolina Panthers.
items.impact: Waller will join the Carolina offense after coming out of retirement to play nine games with the Dolphins last season. Tommy Tremble and Ja'Tavion Sanders had headlined the Carolina tight end room, so Waller could see significant playing time if he stays healthy and finds a connection with Bryce Young.
items.title: Darren Waller signs 1-year deal with Panthers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jadarian Price went through a walkthrough in practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Price makes his return for the first time in five practices. It is a positive sign for the rookie after he has been sidelined the past month.
items.title: Jadarian Price (leg) goes through walkthrough Wednesday
